inlines.v: MONUMENT'AL, adjective Pertaining to a monument; as a monumental inscription. 1. Serving as a monument; memorial; preserving memory. Of pine or monumental oak. A work outlasting monumental brass. 2. Belonging to a tomb; as a monumental rest.
